capabilities: View diagrams on a fullscreen canvas
extras: The current interface uses Chinese labels.
intentEvidence: Mermaid Viewer makes diagrams easier to read in Obsidian.
problem: Mermaid diagrams can be difficult to read or navigate within the standard note view, especially when they are large.
summary: Mermaid Viewer provides a dedicated, fullscreen canvas for viewing Mermaid diagrams, allowing users to zoom, pan, and apply semantic coloring for improved readability.
